findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#Prisma 7.5 操作规范
Note: The module standard pins the adapter construction shape as `new PrismaClient({ adapter: new PrismaPg({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }) })`. The diff instead routes the client through a hand-written subclass that overrides `connect()` and casts `underlyingDriver()` to read pool internals, replacing the documented PrismaPg instantiation idiom with a wrapper around non-public adapter internals within the db layer.

findings.title: Structural drift: placement
findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#文件组织（Elysia 最佳实践）— plugins/ = 自定义 Elysia 插件；utils/ = 跨切面 helper（errors.ts）
Note: The resolved layout puts custom Elysia plugins under src/plugins/ and keeps src/utils/ for framework-agnostic cross-cutting helpers. Here the plugin body lives in utils: Elysia lifecycle handlers (cacheBeforeHandle / cacheMapResponse / cacheAfterResponse), the `Context['set']` typing, `ElysiaCustomStatusResponse` unwrapping and raw Response construction, leaving src/plugins/response-cache.ts as a registration-only shim. It also reuses the same basename (`response-cache.ts`) in two different layers.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#文件组织（Elysia 最佳实践）— plugins/ = 自定义 Elysia 插件；utils/ = 跨切面 helper（errors.ts）.

findings.title: Structural drift: ownership
findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#契约与 API 规范（架构 §5.6 · 决策 #6）+ 文件组织（modules/<域>/index.ts = 路由）
Note: A cross-cutting util hardcodes a route inventory (`/blog/:slug`, `/models/page/:modelSlug`, `/changelog/:id`, …) that duplicates the route surface owned by the module controllers and the content-sdk contract source. Nothing binds these `:param` patterns to the real routes, so the util becomes a second, silently drifting source of routing knowledge outside the module layer.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#契约与 API 规范（架构 §5.6 · 决策 #6）+ 文件组织（modules/<域>/index.ts = 路由）.

notes: No reviewer comments are included in the supplied evidence, so maintainer overlap cannot be assessed.
Author states that the site L2 stale entries (Cache API) were only exercised against a mock and not on real Cloudflare; the diff contains no production validation for it.

Author states that the full astro build was not run locally (no apps/site/.env), so the 10 site tests that depend on build artifacts are unverified; the diff adds site tests but these are unit-level with mocked caches.

Author states that the 'connection silence' failure mode is only mitigated with keepAlive/query_timeout and was not fault-injected; the diff shows only the two option additions in db/client.ts, consistent with that limitation.

Because tests/support/clean-env.ts forces HIAPI_RESPONSE_CACHE_TTL_MS=0, most existing content-api tests do not exercise the cache path; the author acknowledges this and compensates with tests/plugins/response-cache*.test.ts.
The response cache key is derived from method + pathname + canonicalized query plus negotiated locale; the whitelist's per-route audit (REPORT-api.md) is referenced but not present in the diff.

Small wording deviation: the body says 'any non-GET request' clears the cache, while the code clears for any method that is neither GET nor HEAD, and additionally attaches an `x-content-cache: BYPASS` header to shed 503 responses (not listed among the HIT|MISS|COALESCED markers).
